root47.interpretation: 13个upvalue槽位按序捕获父root的T寄存器。UP[0]=R2 MainLeftBottom.b模块状态表；UP[1]=R57在PC360被root.children[6] InstallDamageHook写入的闭包（注意PC357先将root.children[52] onDamageMsg消息处理器写入MainLeftBottom.onDamageMsg，PC360随后覆盖同一T[57]寄存器；PC368的OP_387捕获live cell，因此UP[1]不是消息处理器本身，而是InstallDamageHook安装器）；UP[2]=R41黑名单玩家状态表；UP[3]=R58 DeathAutoBlacklist；UP[4]=R55 FindBlacklistPlayer；UP[5]=R53 GetMapData2DPtr；UP[6]=R38数值2.0；UP[7]=R4 PrintLog；UP[8]=R56 UseItemByIndex；UP[9]=R39数值0.01；UP[10]=R5 ShowLocalNoticeByType；UP[11]=R40数值30.0；UP[12]=R37数组{"随机传送石"}。捕获顺序由root PC368-PC381确认；T57的最终值由PC357-PC360写入时间线确认。

vm_capture_semantics.rule: M() creates each child upvalue proxy with a backing pair {parent_T_table, register_index}; proxy __index reads parent_T[register_index] and __newindex writes parent_T[register_index].
vm_capture_semantics.consequence: OP_387 captures a live shared register cell, not a snapshot value. Later writes to the parent register are visible through every closure capturing that cell.
